name: holdout-vault
description: Keeps confirmed holdout/OOS files sealed. Writes to them are refused (read-only). Opening one (Read, or a Bash command that names it) asks first; once it runs, a BURNED line {date, slug, path} goes to ~/Trading/_ledger/holdout_burns.jsonl. /burn <slug> burns one by hand. A burned holdout opens freely with a toast. List in vault.json; only confirmed: true entries count.
